ms-coa-precinct-lines.area: Mississippi — Attala, Grenada, Hinds, Jones, Leake, Madison, Montgomery, Panola, Tallahatchie and Wayne Counties
ms-coa-precinct-lines.summary: In ten Mississippi counties your Court of Appeals district depends on your voting precinct. There the card names both districts and both districts' judges, because this app cannot tell which side of the line you are on.
ms-coa-precinct-lines.why: The court lists the precincts on one side of each line, and this app has no current map of those counties' voting precincts.
ms-coa-precinct-lines.wanted: A current map of the voting precincts in those ten counties, using the precinct names the court lists.

ms-court-subdistricts.area: Mississippi — the chancery and circuit districts divided into subdistricts
ms-court-subdistricts.summary: In some Mississippi chancery and circuit districts each judge is elected from one part of the district. This app does not draw those parts, so the card lists every judge of the district rather than only the one elected from yours.
ms-court-subdistricts.why: State law draws most of those parts at least partly by voting precinct, and this app has no current map of Mississippi's voting precincts.
ms-court-subdistricts.wanted: Maps of the chancery and circuit subdistricts, or a current statewide map of voting precincts using the names the law lists.

ms-municipal-officeholders.summary: This app can tell you which Mississippi city, town or village you are in, and not who your mayor or council members are.
ms-municipal-officeholders.why: No statewide list of Mississippi's mayors and council or board members has been read yet. The boundary this card draws carries geography and no officeholder at all, and this app never guesses a name.
ms-municipal-officeholders.wanted: A statewide roster of mayors and council or board members by ward, or each city's own published list.

ms-school-board-members.summary: This app names your school district and not the people on its board.
ms-school-board-members.why: No statewide list of Mississippi's school board members has been found. The boundary this card draws carries the district's name and nothing about its board.
ms-school-board-members.wanted: A statewide roster of school board members, or each district's own published list of its board.

ms-supervisor-district-lines.area: Mississippi — the 57 counties whose current supervisor district lines are not confirmed
ms-supervisor-district-lines.summary: In 57 of Mississippi's 82 counties this app names all five supervisors but cannot show which one represents the spot you picked, because it has no confirmed map of the current district lines there.
ms-supervisor-district-lines.why: The Census Bureau's map still carries older lines in most counties, and no statewide map of the current ones has been found. Old lines would name the wrong supervisor for many people, so none are drawn there.
ms-supervisor-district-lines.wanted: Each county's current supervisor district map, or one statewide map of every county's current lines from a state office.
